Independently evaluated the submitted arcsine probability against the earlier published one-visibility triangle solid-angle arctan formula for n=5,6,7,12,32 and three heights each; agreement to numerical precision. Analytic triangle/solid-angle identity establishes general equivalence, not the finite numerical checks.
